mail.button_broken: Button not working? Paste this link into your browser:
mail.q_email: Questions? Reply to this email or write to {email}.
mail.q_chat: Questions? {chat}, we usually reply within minutes.
mail.why: You’re getting this because you have a Joinvoo account or wrote to our support.
welcome.subject: Welcome to Joinvoo: confirm your email
welcome.preheader: One tap to confirm your email, then connect your first channel in about 10 minutes.
welcome.title: Welcome to Joinvoo
welcome.lead: Your account is ready. Confirm this is your email.
welcome.lead_free: Your account is ready. Confirm this is your email to unlock your first {n} tracked joins free.
welcome.after: Stuck? The {guide} has a picture for every step.
email_verified.subject: Your Joinvoo email is confirmed
email_verified.preheader: Your account is live and your {n} free joins are ready.
email_verified.title: Email confirmed
email_verified.lead: Thanks for confirming your email. Your Joinvoo account is live and ready to go.
email_verified.lead_free: Thanks for confirming your email. Your Joinvoo account is live, and you’ve got {n} free tracked joins waiting for you.
email_verified.p1: Open your dashboard to connect your first channel, paste your pixel, and start tracking the ads that bring real people into Telegram.
email_verified.after: Stuck? The {guide} has a picture for every step.
reset.subject: Reset your Joinvoo password
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password for this Joinvoo account.
reset.callout: The link works for 1 hour and only once. If it wasn’t you, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
pwchanged.subject: Your Joinvoo password was changed
pwchanged.preheader: If this was you, you’re all set.
pwchanged.title: Your password was changed
pwchanged.lead: The password for your Joinvoo account was changed on {when}.
pwchanged.p1: If this was you, there’s nothing to do. Other devices were signed out.
pwchanged.callout: Wasn’t you? Reset your password right away and tell our support team.
payment.subject: Receipt: {credits} Joinvoo credits added
payment.title: Payment received
payment.lead: Thanks! {amount} credits ({usd}) were added. Tracking keeps running.
payment.lead_bonus: Thanks! {amount} credits ({usd}) were added, plus {bonus} bonus credits. Tracking keeps running.
payment.after: 1 credit = $0.01. Credits pay for tracking and can’t be withdrawn or refunded; bonus credits work the same way.
review.subject: We got your top-up. Checking it now
review.preheader: Your balance updates as soon as we confirm the transfer.
review.title: Your top-up is being checked
review.lead: We received your transfer details. Your balance updates as soon as we confirm it, usually within 30 minutes.
review.p1: You don’t need to do anything else. We’ll email you when it lands.
rejected.subject: We couldn’t confirm your Joinvoo top-up
rejected.preheader: Here’s what happened and what to do next.
rejected.title: We couldn’t confirm your top-up
rejected.lead: Your {label} top-up of {amount} wasn’t added to your wallet.
rejected.p1: If you did send the money, reply with the transaction details (or a screenshot) and we’ll sort it out quickly.
low.subject: Your Joinvoo credits are low ({n} left)
low.preheader: Buy credits so tracking doesn’t pause.
low.title: Your credits are running low
low.lead: You have {n} credits (≈ {usd}) left. Each extra tracked join uses {per} credits, so tracking will pause soon.
low.p1: When the wallet is empty your ads keep working and visitors still get into Telegram, but joins stop being tracked and sent to Meta, TikTok and Snapchat.
paused.subject: Tracking is paused on your Joinvoo account
paused.preheader: Your ads still work. Top up to start tracking again.
paused.title: Tracking is paused
paused.lead_plan: Your monthly plan ({usd}) is due and your wallet can’t cover it yet.
paused.lead_empty: Your wallet ran out, so new joins aren’t being tracked.
paused.callout: Your ads are fine. Visitors still reach your Telegram channel. Only tracking and sending joins to your ad platform is paused.
paused.p1: Top up and tracking starts again on the very next click.
free80.subject: You’ve used {used} of your {gift} free joins
free80.title: Your free joins are almost used
free80.lead: Nice work. Your ads have brought {used} tracked joins so far.
free80.p1: After that, the plan is {base}/month with {included} tracked joins included, then {per}¢ per extra join. Top up now so tracking never pauses.
freedone.subject: Your free joins are used up
freedone.preheader: Top up to keep tracking every join.
freedone.title: All {gift} free joins used
freedone.lead: Your welcome gift is fully used. From the next ad click, the monthly plan applies.
freedone.p1: If the wallet can’t cover the plan, tracking pauses, but visitors still get into your channel.
payreq.subject: We got your {amount} withdrawal request
payreq.title: Withdrawal requested
payreq.lead: We’ve got your request. It usually lands within 24 hours.
payreq.p1: Check the address above. If it’s wrong, reply right away so we can fix it before sending.
paysent.subject: Your {amount} payout was sent 🎉
paysent.title: Your payout is on its way
paysent.lead: We sent {amount} in {method}. Thanks for bringing people to Joinvoo.
payrej.subject: Your Joinvoo withdrawal wasn’t sent
payrej.preheader: The money is back in your referral balance.
payrej.title: Your withdrawal wasn’t sent
payrej.lead: We couldn’t send your {amount} withdrawal. The full amount is back in your referral balance.
payrej.p1: You can request it again any time, or move it to your wallet to pay for tracking.
reply.subject: {agent} replied to your message
reply.title: You have a new reply
weekly.subject: Your week on Joinvoo: {joins} tracked joins
weekly.title: Your week in numbers
weekly.lead: Here’s what your ads did from {from} to {to}.
trial_started.subject: Your Pro trial is on: see which ads drive deposits
trial_started.preheader: {days} days or {limit} deposits, whichever comes first.
trial_started.title: Your Pro trial has started
trial_started.lead: Your first tracked deposit just came in, so your Pro trial is on. For the next {days} days or {limit} deposits, whichever comes first, you see exactly which campaigns, ad sets and ads drive deposits.
trial_started.lead_signup: Your Pro trial is on. For the next {days} days or {limit} deposits, whichever comes first, you see exactly which campaigns, ad sets and ads drive deposits.
trial_started.p1: After the trial, deposits are still matched and sent to Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, so your ads keep learning. Upgrade to Pro to keep seeing which ads drove them.
trial_ending.subject: Your Pro trial ends soon
trial_ending.title: Your Pro trial is almost over
trial_ending.lead: You’ve tracked {used} of {limit} deposits in your trial, and it ends on {date} at the latest.
trial_ending.p1: Keep Pro to keep seeing revenue, ROAS and cost per FTD by campaign, ad set and ad.
trial_ended.subject: Your Pro trial has ended
trial_ended.preheader: Deposits are still sent to your ads. Upgrade to see which ads drove them.
trial_ended.title: Your Pro trial has ended
trial_ended.lead: Thanks for trying Pro. You tracked {used} deposits during your trial.
trial_ended.callout: Your ads keep learning. On Basic, deposits are still matched and sent to Meta, TikTok and Snapchat.
trial_ended.p1: On Basic you see how many deposits came in. Upgrade to Pro to see which campaigns, ad sets and ads drove them, with revenue and ROAS.
pro_welcome.subject: Welcome to Joinvoo {plan}
pro_welcome.preheader: Revenue, ROAS and cost per FTD for every ad.
pro_welcome.title: You’re on {plan}
pro_welcome.lead: Every deposit now shows the campaign, ad set and ad that drove it, with revenue, ROAS and cost per FTD.
plan_changed.subject: Your Joinvoo plan is changing
plan_changed.preheader: Deposits keep being sent to your ads on every plan.
plan_changed.title: Your plan
plan_changed.lead: You’ll move to {to} on {date}. You keep {from} until then.
plan_changed.p1: Deposits keep being matched and sent to your ads on every plan. You can switch back any time from your wallet.
meet_joe.subject: Meet Joe, your media-buying assistant
meet_joe.preheader: He watches your numbers all day and tells you what to fix.
meet_joe.title: Meet Joe 👋
meet_joe.lead: Joe is your Joinvoo assistant. He watches your joins, deposits, spend and channels, and tells you what needs a look.
meet_joe.spots_v: Joins stopping, invite links running low, costs going up
meet_joe.never_v: If a number is missing, he says so
rank_up.subject: You reached {rank} on Joinvoo
rank_up.preheader: New perks are on your account.
rank_up.title: Welcome to {rank}
rank_up.lead: Your top-ups have moved you up to {rank}. Here’s what comes with it.
level_up.subject: You just hit {level} {emoji}
level_up.title: You’re a {level} now {emoji}
level_up.lead: Your ads brought {leads} leads (tracked joins and bot starts) in the last 30 days. That makes you a {level} on Joinvoo.
level_up.next: Next level: {next} at {from} leads. {need} to go.
level_up.top: You’re at the top of the ladder. Respect.
level_up.p1: Levels follow your last 30 days, so they move with your traffic.
credits.subject_add: {n} Joinvoo credits added to your wallet
credits.subject_remove: {n} Joinvoo credits removed from your wallet
credits.lead_add: Our team added {n} credits (≈ {usd}) to your wallet.
credits.lead_remove: Our team removed {n} credits (≈ {usd}) from your wallet.
credits.after: Gift credits pay for tracking. They can’t be withdrawn or refunded.
alert.paused: ⏸️ Tracking is paused: your Joinvoo credits ran out. Your ads still work and visitors still get in. Buy credits to resume tracking.
alert.token_bot: 🔴 Telegram stopped accepting the token of @{bot}. Tracking through this bot has stopped. Reconnect it in Channels.
alert.platform_refused: 🔴 {platform} refused events: {err}. Check the pixel ID and access token in Channels.
alert.links_low: ⚠️ {title}: only {n} ready invite links. Heavy traffic is using them faster than your bot can make them. Add a second bot to this channel to double the speed.
alert.cpa_spike: 📈 Cost per first deposit jumped to {now} yesterday, vs {avg} average last week.
alert.no_joins_2h: 😶 No joins on {title} for 2 hours. It usually gets about {usual} in these hours. Check that your ads are running and the bot is still an admin.
alert.no_ftd_campaign: 🕕 {campaign} had {n} first deposits yesterday and none so far today. Check the offer link and the ads in this campaign.
alert.daily_locked: Revenue and ROAS by ad are part of Pro.
alertbot.expired: That link has expired. Open Joinvoo → Settings → Telegram alerts and tap Connect again.
alertbot.connected: ✅ Connected. You’ll get Joinvoo alerts here: broken tokens, invite links running low, tracking paused, and a morning report. Change them any time in your dashboard. Send /stop to turn alerts off.
alertbot.stopped: Alerts are off. Connect again from your Joinvoo dashboard any time.
alertbot.help: Open Joinvoo → Settings → Telegram alerts and tap Connect to link this chat.
inbox.alert_token: An ad platform or bot is refusing your events
inbox.fake_body: Join bursts, deleted accounts, repeat users and bot clicks were kept away from your ad platforms, so your pixels learn from real people. You weren’t charged for them.
country.locked: You can change your country again on {date}.
staff.subject: You’re on the Joinvoo team ({role})
staff.preheader: Set your password to open the admin panel.
staff.title: Welcome to the team: {role}
staff.lead: {by} added you to the Joinvoo admin team as {role}.
staff.p_new: Choose a password with the button above (the link works for 7 days), then open {admin} and log in with this email.
staff.p_existing: Log in at {admin} with your usual Joinvoo email and password. You only see the sections your role allows.
staff.callout: Didn’t expect this? Ignore this email and nothing changes.
voo.linked_title: Your account is now linked to VooSquare
voo.linked_body: You can log in to Joinvoo with your VooSquare account from now on. Your data, balance and settings stay the same.
